questions.q: Which workload is CPU compute realistically enough for?
options: Low-throughput API calls, classical ML scoring, and small embedding models
Fine-tuning a large language model from scratch
High-throughput embedding generation across millions of documents
Training a large image generation model
questions.explain: CPU is fine for lightweight inference work; heavier training and high-throughput generation are where GPU earns its cost.

questions.q: What do Azure OpenAI's pay-as-you-go tier and provisioned throughput units (PTUs) have in common?
options: They both abstract away the underlying VM size — you pay for tokens or reserved capacity, not a server size
They both require you to manually select a GPU VM SKU
They are only available for CPU-based models
They require an AKS cluster to be running first
questions.explain: Managed services sidestep the CPU-vs-GPU decision entirely by billing on tokens or reserved capacity instead of a VM size.

questions.q: What is Azure's ND-series GPU VM family built for?
options: Visualization and virtual desktops
Large-scale deep learning across multiple GPUs per VM, for models too big for one card
General-purpose web hosting with no GPU at all
Database transaction processing
questions.explain: ND-series exists specifically for deep learning workloads that need multiple GPUs working together in one VM.

questions.q: Why would picking an NV-series VM for model fine-tuning be a mistake, even though it has a GPU?
options: NV-series doesn't actually include a GPU
NV-series VMs can't run Linux
NV-series is tuned for visualization and virtual desktops, not training workloads
NV-series is more expensive than ND-series for the same training job
questions.explain: The GPU is there, but it's purpose-built for visualization/VDI scenarios rather than the compute pattern training workloads need.

questions.q: What does `az vm list-skus --location eastus --size Standard_NC --output table` actually tell you?
options: The current Azure OpenAI token price in that region
Which NC-series GPU sizes are actually available to deploy in the eastus region right now
How many virtual machines are currently running in your subscription
Whether your subscription has GPU quota approved
questions.explain: list-skus reports which sizes are actually sellable in a given region — a sanity check before designing around a SKU that may be unavailable there.
